title: Centered spectral truncation controls a single comparator by entropy and original disturbance

statement.quantifiers: Every bistochastic Phi, canonical EB Psi with 0<=I-Psi<=C(I-RePhi), every density rho and K>1.
statement.assertion: ||rho-Psi rho||1<=2D(rho||I/d)/lnK+sqrt((C/2)K||rho-Phi rho||1); same Psi for every rho and K, and tracial-mean ensemble average gives 4H/ln(1/epsilon)+sqrt(C/2)epsilon^(1/4).
assumptions: Psi positive selfadjoint HS contraction, actual comparator order.
Mean I/d only when identifying average D with ensemble Holevo information.

inputs: Original channel disturbance, tracial relative entropy, K and common Psi.
outputs: Statewise and averaged full-trace reconstruction bound.
interface.precision: Exact finite functional calculus; K limit at zero disturbance.
costs: Binary general C8 versus reversible C4 distinguished; average one-prior result is not capacity-uniform all-label theorem.

proof_mechanism: Scalar convex primitive inequality for g=min(x,K) creates a squared-difference term.
Common-marginal spectral transition weights cancel primitive terms without symmetry.
Center g-K/2 uses zero-trace residual and improves the constant.
Convex entropy h tail gives t<=D/lnK; two TP positive tail legs, then Jensen.
obstructions: Transition weights are not necessarily row-normalized or symmetric.
No commutation with truncation or normality assumed; no arbitrary-reference/diamond claim.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Prove a valid scalar primitive orientation and common-marginal cancellation before converting entropy tails into trace error.

review.source_reported: Source reports internally reconstructed mathematics with scoped independent analytic audits; finite checks are not proof certification; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
